notes.subject: sa yona
notes.rationale: Hebrew שמעה lacks a possessive; 'sa yona' (of it, i.e. of wisdom) supplied from context

notes.subject: שמענו שמעה
notes.rationale: verb 'we heard' and noun 'a hearing/report' share the root שמע; Sepedi loses the sound-echo

notes.subject: Abadone le lehu
notes.rationale: the deepest hidden realms themselves possess only a rumor of wisdom — personification of the concealed world

translation: Abadone le lehu di re: ka masweng a rena re kwele ⟨segaonthati⟩ sa yona.
